Hamad Bin Khalifa University, part of Qatar Foundation's Education City in Doha, offers funded master's and PhD programmes across computing, law, sustainability, health and engineering colleges. Its admissions portal lists priority and final rounds for each intake, with generous scholarship packages for admitted students.

Programme Highlights

  • Fully funded graduate scholarships at Education City, Doha
  • Colleges spanning computing, law, public policy, sustainability and health
  • Priority and final admission rounds per programme
  • Research ties to Qatar Foundation institutes and industry

Who Should Apply

Bachelor's and master's graduates targeting English-taught Gulf-region graduate study with funding; programme prerequisites vary by college.

Funding and Costs

Full scholarships for admitted students typically cover tuition, accommodation and other support components, per the admissions page.

Deadline and How to Apply

Open the HBKU admissions page, select your programme, and submit within the priority round where possible for scholarship consideration. Key deadline information: Priority and final rounds per programme — dates published on the HBKU admissions portal.
